title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web | TechCrunch
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella predicts that the rise of AI agents is going to reshape the economics of the internet, impacting the business models of the companies that rely on advertising and what he referred to as “human web” traffic.
